entities.name: Tim
entities.description: One of the two speakers: a student and lifelong Harry Potter and fantasy-literature fan. He runs a Harry Potter fan project, joined an online fantasy literature forum in June 2023, writes articles about fantasy novels for an online magazine from August 2023, is midway through his own fantasy novel, learns piano, violin and German, joined a travel club in December 2023, and was accepted on 5 January 2024 for a semester in Galway, Ireland. He met John on 21 May 2023 and they have been close friends since.

entities.name: John
entities.description: One of the two speakers: a professional basketball player who signed with the Minnesota Wolves as a shooting guard in May 2023. He married in late September 2023, collects sneakers and jerseys, surfs, hikes, cooks, does yoga and strength training, mentors younger players, runs youth-sports charity work, and signed endorsement deals with Nike, an outdoor gear company and a beverage company. He met Tim on 21 May 2023.

entities.name: John's wife
entities.description: John's partner, never named in the conversation. They married in a greenhouse ceremony in the week before 2 October 2023, had their first dance at a cosy restaurant, took a European coastal road trip in November 2023, and hosted a small get-together with friends and family in December 2023 to celebrate his recovery from injury.

entities.name: Anthony
entities.description: A friend of John's. The two went to a charity event together before August 2023 and took part in its Harry Potter trivia contest, where another guest won a signed Harry Potter book.

entities.name: LeBron James
entities.description: The basketball player both speakers admire. He is John's favourite player, whom John has met several times and watched play live, and the player who signed the cased basketball Tim keeps as his prized possession. On 6 November 2023 both recalled his chase-down block on Iguodala in Game 7 of the 2016 Finals.

entities.name: J.K. Rowling
entities.description: The author of the Harry Potter books and the writer Tim names as his greatest inspiration. He has read her work for a long time, takes notes on her style for his own novel, and quotes her line about turning on the light because happiness hides in the darkest of times.

entities.name: Patrick Rothfuss
entities.description: The author of The Name of the Wind. Tim recommended his work to John on 9 August 2023, named the book on 11 August 2023, recommended it again as travel reading on 21 September 2023, and was still reading it on 7 January 2024.

entities.name: Emma Watson
entities.description: The lead actress of the Harry Potter films. Tim named her for John on 26 December 2023 and said he is a huge fan, particularly of her gender-equality and women's-rights advocacy.

entities.name: George R. R. Martin
entities.description: The author of the Game of Thrones novels. As of 8 December 2023 Tim had read only that series of his, and John had read none of his books but said he would check them out.

entities.name: Frank Herbert
entities.description: The author of Dune, the novel John was reading and recommending on 8 December 2023.

entities.name: London
entities.description: The city where Tim visited a Harry Potter attraction and took a tour a few years before May 2023, an experience he described as like walking into a Harry Potter film.

entities.name: United Kingdom
entities.description: The country, also called the UK, that Tim travelled to for a Harry Potter conference in early October 2023 and where he visited a castle on 10 November 2023. Its castles, which he read a book about in October 2023, gave him ideas for his fantasy novel, and a story he tried to base on the trip did not work out.

entities.name: Scotland
entities.description: Part of the United Kingdom and the country Edinburgh is in; Tim named both when recommending the city to John on 21 September 2023.

entities.name: Edinburgh
entities.description: The Scottish city Tim recommended to John on 21 September 2023 as a destination for the Minnesota Wolves team trip, calling it the birthplace of Harry Potter and praising its history, architecture and magical feel. John had never been and said it was worth considering.

entities.name: Seattle
entities.description: One of John's favourite cities, where he had a game scheduled for August 2023. He loves its energy, diversity, local seafood and the support of the fans there; Tim said he has always wanted to try the seafood.

entities.name: Chicago
entities.description: The city John visited in early August 2023, praising its energy and friendly locals. He rejoined his teammates on 15 August 2023 after the trip.

entities.name: New York City
entities.description: The city, also called NYC, that John has visited and strongly recommends for its culture and restaurants, though he found the subway confusing until a stranger explained it. Tim added it to his travel list on 26 August 2023 and John offered to help him plan a visit.

entities.name: California
entities.description: Where the fellow Harry Potter fan Tim met in July 2023 lives. Tim spoke to that fan again over Skype around 9 August 2023 and they discussed characters and a possible collaboration.

entities.name: Universal Studios
entities.description: The theme park Tim planned to visit for the first time in September 2023, mainly for its Harry Potter attractions. John had not been but said it was on his bucket list.

entities.name: Smoky Mountains
entities.description: The mountains Tim travelled to in 2022, where he took the sunset photograph he shared with John on 17 October 2023.

entities.name: Rocky Mountains
entities.description: The mountains John visited in 2022 on a trip he described on 1 December 2023 as stunning, with mountain views and fresh air that made him realise how incredible the world is.

entities.name: Europe
entities.description: Where John and his wife took a short holiday from early November 2023, road-tripping along the coastline; Tim recommended they visit castles. John also holidayed in Italy in December 2023 and has visited Paris.

entities.name: Italy
entities.description: Where John holidayed in December 2023, praising the food, history and architecture, and where he bought a cookbook that has been giving him cooking inspiration. Tim has never been but has it on his list.

entities.name: Paris
entities.description: The city John has visited and loved, praising the view from the Eiffel Tower. Tim has not been and said on 2 January 2024 that he cannot wait to see it.

entities.name: Ireland
entities.description: The country Tim was due to spend a semester in from February 2024 on a study-abroad programme, staying in Galway.

entities.name: Galway
entities.description: The Irish city Tim chose to stay in for his semester abroad from February 2024, for its arts scene, Irish music and vibrant atmosphere.

entities.name: Cliffs of Moher
entities.description: The Irish cliffs Tim most wanted to visit during his semester in Galway, for their ocean views. John said on 7 January 2024 that he might stop by there after his season.

entities.name: Barcelona
entities.description: The city John recommended to Tim on 12 January 2024 for its culture, architecture, food and nearby beaches; Tim added it to his travel list.

entities.name: Himalayas
entities.description: The mountain range crossed by the two hikers whose account, in the collection of travellers' stories Tim read in December 2023, motivated him: a tough trek with difficult terrain, altitude sickness and bad weather that ended in amazing sights.

entities.name: Minnesota Wolves
entities.description: The professional basketball team, which John calls the Wolves, that he signed with in May 2023 as a shooting guard and which is also his favourite team. His teammates are like a second family to him: they gave him a signed basketball when he rejoined them on 15 August 2023, he began mentoring the younger players in October 2023, and the team won a trophy by October 2023.

entities.name: Nike
entities.description: The sportswear brand John was considering in June 2023 and had signed a basketball shoe and gear endorsement deal with by 16 July 2023.

entities.name: Gatorade
entities.description: The sports-drink brand John said on 16 July 2023 he was in talks with about a potential sponsorship.

entities.name: Under Armour
entities.description: A sportswear brand John was considering in June 2023 and said on 16 July 2023 he had always liked and would love to work with.

entities.name: MinaLima
entities.description: The design studio that created the props for the Harry Potter films. Tim loves their work and keeps one of their pictures by his bookshelf, calling it like having a piece of the wizarding world at home.

entities.name: online fantasy literature forum
entities.description: The online forum Tim joined on 14 June 2023 and where he had an enriching first conversation about his favourite books. It is also where he found the article-writing opportunity that led to his work for an online fantasy magazine.

entities.name: online fantasy magazine
entities.description: The online magazine Tim began writing articles about fantasy novels for by 2 August 2023, analysing characters and themes and making book recommendations. He found the opening on a fantasy literature forum and they liked the ideas he pitched.

entities.name: travel club
entities.description: The travel club Tim joined around 6 December 2023 out of interest in other cultures and countries and a wish to meet new people. On 2 January 2024 he described the same group as globetrotters who share his interests and whose trips he enjoys hearing about.

entities.name: hiking club
entities.description: The hiking club John had only just joined by 2 October 2023; some of its members still came to his wedding.

entities.name: Harry Potter
entities.description: The book and film series, often called HP by the two speakers, that is at the centre of Tim's life: the subject of his fan project, his London visit, his UK conference, his Harry Potter party, his themed Christmas tree and his favourite book, and the series whose props MinaLima made. John is a fan too, owns the whole film collection and took part in a Harry Potter trivia contest at a charity event.

entities.name: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
entities.description: The first Harry Potter film, which Tim named on 21 August 2023 as special to him for the memory of watching it with his family under a blanket with snacks. Its theme is his favourite piece to play on the piano, and John said he loves the film too.

entities.name: Game of Thrones
entities.description: George R. R. Martin's fantasy series, abbreviated GoT by the speakers, which Tim named alongside Harry Potter as his favourite on 2 August 2023, still called a favourite on 21 November 2023, and analysed for his English literature class in December 2023.

entities.name: A Dance with Dragons
entities.description: The Game of Thrones novel Tim had just finished and recommended to John on 8 December 2023, calling it a really good story.

entities.name: The Name of the Wind
entities.description: Patrick Rothfuss's fantasy novel about a magician and musician protagonist, praised by Tim for its world-building and character development. He recommended it to John on 11 August 2023 and again on 21 September 2023 as travel reading, and was reading it himself on 7 January 2024.

entities.name: The Alchemist
entities.description: One of Tim's favourite novels, which he spotted on John's bookshelf on 21 September 2023. John had read and loved it for its message about following one's dreams, and reread it in November 2023, finding it inspiring and motivating.

entities.name: The Hobbit
entities.description: The novel John spotted on Tim's reorganised bookshelf on 1 December 2023 and named as one of his favourites too.

entities.name: The Lord of the Rings
entities.description: The fantasy series, abbreviated LOTR, that Tim called his favourite on 26 December 2023 and whose map of Middle-earth he keeps. John named it as his favourite fantasy film series on 2 January 2024, with Aragorn as his favourite character for his growth from ranger to king of Gondor, his bravery and his selflessness; John keeps a painting of him as a reminder to stay true and lead well.

entities.name: Star Wars
entities.description: The film series Tim named as his favourite on 2 January 2024, saying it never gets old.

entities.name: Home Alone
entities.description: One of the films Tim's family watch together at Thanksgiving; he says it always brings lots of laughs.

entities.name: Elf
entities.description: A holiday film Tim's family watch together, which he says makes them laugh and feel festive.

entities.name: The Santa Clause
entities.description: A holiday film Tim's family watch together, which he calls heartwarming; John called it a classic that captures the Christmas magic.

entities.name: Dune
entities.description: Frank Herbert's novel, which John was reading and recommending on 8 December 2023, describing it as a story about religion and human control over ecology. Tim had not read it but had heard good things.

entities.name: The Wheel of Time
entities.description: The television series adapted from a book series Tim loves. On 26 December 2023 he said it was coming out the following month and that he could not wait to see the books come to life on screen.

entities.name: John's lucky basketball shoes
entities.description: The basketball shoes John has worn since the start of his career. He showed them to Tim on 11 August 2023 and said every mark has a story and that they stand for resilience, determination and his love of the game.

entities.name: the basketball signed by John's teammates
entities.description: The basketball John's Minnesota Wolves teammates signed and gave him when he rejoined them on 15 August 2023, as a sign of their friendship. He keeps it as a comforting reminder of their bond and of why he started playing.

entities.name: Tim's signed basketball
entities.description: Tim's prized possession: a cased basketball signed by his favourite player, LeBron James, which he showed John on 6 November 2023 and keeps as a reminder of all the hard work.

entities.name: Tim's book collection
entities.description: The bookshelf of fantasy novels Tim has shown John repeatedly from June 2023 onwards. It holds his favourites, including Harry Potter, Game of Thrones and The Hobbit, and the MinaLima picture stands with it; he reorganised it at the end of November 2023.

entities.name: Tim's MinaLima picture
entities.description: The MinaLima print displayed with Tim's bookshelf, which he described on 15 June 2023 as like having a piece of the wizarding world at home.

entities.name: basketball
entities.description: John's sport and profession. He watched NBA games with his father as a child, was signed up to a local league at ten, played through middle and high school, earned a college scholarship and was drafted after college. He had been playing professionally for just under a year as of December 2023 and practises and trains daily.

entities.name: surfing
entities.description: The sport John took up around 2018 and loves for its connection to nature. He spent a summer surfing with friends and describes the waves and wind as exciting and freeing.

entities.name: reading fantasy literature
entities.description: Tim's central pastime and his escape from reality; he reads Harry Potter, Game of Thrones and other fantasy constantly, and it feeds both his magazine articles and his own novel. He also reads books on growth and psychology. John reads fantasy and non-fiction personal-development books, and picked reading back up after talking to Tim in October 2023.

entities.name: fantasy writing
entities.description: Tim's writing practice: articles about fantasy novels for an online magazine from August 2023 and his own fantasy novel from late 2023. He draws inspiration from books, films, real-life experiences and above all from J.K. Rowling.

entities.name: playing the piano
entities.description: The instrument Tim began learning in August 2023; by 6 December 2023 he had been playing about four months and was enjoying his progress. His favourite piece to play is the theme from Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone.

entities.name: playing the violin
entities.description: The instrument Tim had recently started learning as of 6 December 2023. He is mainly into classical music but wants to try jazz and film scores, and finds it a way to relax and be creative.

entities.name: cooking
entities.description: John's therapy away from the court and a way to be creative with flavours. He improvised a butternut soup with sage in August 2023, makes honey garlic chicken with roasted vegetables often, and bought a cookbook in Italy in December 2023.

entities.name: yoga
entities.description: The practice John had taken up by 1 December 2023 for extra strength and flexibility, which he says has also improved his focus and balance during workouts. Warrior II is a favourite pose and he holds his balance poses for 30 to 60 seconds.

entities.name: strength training
entities.description: Half of the routine John built at his new gym in August 2023, alongside basketball work and rest. He credits it with building muscle and power, preventing injuries, and improving his shooting accuracy, agility and speed.

entities.name: hiking
entities.description: John hikes, joined a hiking club in 2023, received hiking gear in his outdoor-gear endorsement and found the river spot used in its photoshoot while out hiking. Tim hikes on road trips with friends and family.

entities.name: travel
entities.description: A shared interest. John loves discovering new cities, travels for games and holidays and recommends destinations to Tim. Tim loves travelling for a different kind of magic, joined a travel club in December 2023, read travellers' stories, visited a travel agency and was researching visa requirements in January 2024.

entities.name: learning German
entities.description: The language Tim was learning as of 2 January 2024. He finds it tough but worth it and likes its structure, and says it is easier than the French he took in high school.

entities.name: learning Spanish
entities.description: The language John had just started learning as of 2 January 2024, using a phone app, because he considers it useful for personal and professional opportunities. He already knows a bit of German.

entities.name: John's 2023 leg injury
entities.description: The injury John was dealing with from mid-November 2023. His doctor said it was not too serious; he missed games, hated being off the court, did physical therapy exercises daily, jogged pain-free again on 15 December 2023 and was practising and training every day by January 2024.

entities.name: Harry Potter fan project
entities.description: The fan project Tim was working on from May 2023, discussing collaborations about the characters, spells and magical creatures of the Harry Potter universe. A Harry Potter fan friend was helping him work out ideas in May 2023, and a fellow fan he met in California in July 2023 discussed collaborating with him over Skype in August 2023.

entities.name: Tim's fantasy novel
entities.description: The fantasy novel Tim was midway through by 21 October 2023, inspired by J.K. Rowling and by a book about British castles. He got stuck on a plot twist at the end of October 2023 but pushed through, and in mid-November 2023 a story he tried to base on his UK trip did not turn out as he wanted.

entities.name: John's youth sports charity work
entities.description: John's work off the court: a partnership from August 2023 with a local organisation helping disadvantaged children through sport and school, a week-long basketball camp in his hometown in summer 2023, seminars on sport and marketing from December 2023, and a benefit basketball game at the start of January 2024 that raised money for charity. His aim is fair access to good sports programmes for underserved communities.

entities.name: Tim's semester abroad in Ireland
entities.description: The study-abroad programme Tim applied for and was accepted onto on 5 January 2024, taking him to Galway, Ireland for a semester from February 2024. He wants to explore Irish nature and visit the Cliffs of Moher, and was researching visa requirements on 12 January 2024.

John rejoined his Minnesota Wolves teammates after his trip to Chicago and they gave him a basketball they had all signed
Tim gave a presentation in class, nervous but through it, and counted it as progress
Tim visited a castle in the UK and found its architecture and history unbelievable
John set a career high in assists in the Minnesota Wolves' big game against their rivals
John jogged at the gym with no pain for the first time since his injury
Tim was accepted onto the study abroad programme that would take him to Galway, Ireland
